scope: Alarm presentation and record gates only. Original requirements, source versions, expected/native values, cause units and five-PR denominators remain unchanged.
gate: Do not read/build actual alarm material or dispatch alarm roles until all fifteen versions' thirty effective independent cause seals and their global index verify. The same original own-version actors adjudicate alarms; no sibling grade, tool identity, A/B mapping or cost is supplied.

selection.all_groups_before_dispatch: Seal all fifteen explicit artifact-selection specs using this same rule before the first alarm task. No filtering by observed defect status or preferred result.
selection.initial: All original initial-source public acquisition reports/reviews, labeled as neutral repeats, plus the registered initial private acquisition reports. Initial material remains common research; no final worker self-claim is assigned to the initial reference.
selection.final: All of the own arm's public requests from D0 through final self-seal, all original source/image submissions they bind, the final worker self-claim, and the registered original final private acquisition reports. Do not include later independent-grade-generated bindings as original tool alarms.
selection.native: Retain all original native fields including issues, except top-level operation-cost metadata. Original PNG bytes and state/epoch bindings remain exact. Byte-identical image aliases may reuse an inspected original with recorded SHA proof.
selection.reports: Retain whole automatic/evaluated assertion arrays, findings, routed work/diagnostic/responsibility/admission rows, original review submissions and worker claim statements. Provide all P/F/U and positive validation context; do not preselect only a known failed assertion.
selection.source: Supply byte-exact original source capsules for the source versions actually supporting each alarm. A missing intermediate source version stays explicitly unavailable; current source cannot substitute. Existing own fixed packet and identical source-contract supplement remain available.
selection.missing: Preserve original failed/missing/partial material and its pinned availability/error record. Missing acquisition, unsupported observation and unknown work are never manufactured product alarms.

projection.copies: Code, contracts and PNGs are exact original bytes, with external byte pins and no resize, redraw or expected-value rewrite.
projection.json: Only explicitly declared outer identity/cost/execution metadata omissions and exact machine-path/tool-name substitutions at whitelisted metadata string pointers. Preserve every other field, array order, status, expected and measured value. Keep original bytes, original SHA, exact selections, changed pointers and before/after values in the separate operator ledger.
projection.fail_closed: An unexpected identity-bearing or unprojectable fact stops preparation with the failed original version retained. Never redact a rendered/expected/measured value, silently drop an alarm, or dispatch an incomplete/unsealed packet. Any generic presentation correction is applied uniformly before any alarm role receives material.

adjudication.units: Deduplicate repeated rows/states by actual product cause or false-alarm claim. Different platform implementations remain separate absent positive common-source/design-interpretation evidence.
adjudication.positive_claims: A false positive-validation/pass claim is recorded separately and may evidence a miss; it is not silently counted as a false product-defect alarm.
adjudication.corrections: Never overwrite the first cause grade. Any new evidence-backed cause or correction belongs to an explicitly sealed appendix for the later blind matcher, with original judgments retained.
adjudication.zero_denominators: No genuine or adjudicated defect-alarm denominator gives N/A, never invented defects or a zero-percent claim.
